name: Jack In The Box Inc.
business_overview: Jack in the Box Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, operates, and franchises quick-service restaurants (QSR) in the United States. It operates through Jack in the Box and Del Taco segments. The company engages in the operation of a hamburger chain under the Jack in the Box brand; and a Mexican-American QSR chain under the Del Taco brand. The company was formerly known as Foodmaker, Inc and changed its name to Jack in the Box Inc. in November 1999. Jack in the Box Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Quick-service restaurant chain operating Jack in the Box and Del Taco brands in the US.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** The top-line environment remains challenging, with same-store sales under pressure from declining guest traffic, partially cushioned by menu price increases. However, trends have begun to improve sequentially into the third quarter, offering a tentative signal of stabilization. Elevated commodity and labor cost inflation continue to weigh on unit-level profitability, though the brand is not facing unique competitive displacement; rather, it is navigating broad quick-service sector headwinds that are squeezing consumer visits.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is in a transitional phase under Interim CEO Mark King, a board member stepping into the role with a mandate to accelerate the existing “Jack on Track” turnaround plan. The focus is squarely on operational urgency, elevating the guest experience, and tightening cost controls. Management acknowledges that second-quarter results fell short of expectations but is striking a cautiously optimistic tone by pointing to improving early third-quarter trends, signaling a commitment to regain credibility through execution rather than aspirational rhetoric.

Posted by Dante Gardener on May 13th, 2026

Jack In The Box (NASDAQ:JACK– Get Free Report) released its quarterly earnings data on Wednesday. The restaurant operator reported $0.76 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $0.74 by $0.02, FiscalAI reports. The business had revenue of $254.26 million for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $256.55 million. Jack In The Box had a negative net margin of 8.69% and a negative return on equity of 7.12%. The company’s revenue was down 24.5% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $1.20 earnings per share.
